record.title: From Events to Reasoning: Hierarchical Rule Composition over Explicit States
record.summary: arXiv:2610.22403v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: What a reasoning system emits is a conclusion; what it owes is a justification. Producing one requires every operation to be admissible on the facts actually available, the dependencies of intermediate results to survive to the end
